steps.title: Cost: joint plan $3,108
steps.message: Two trucks can't cover three tanks, so the optimizer tried every split of the fleet. Sending the trucks to B and A and shutting in S2_WELL_C1 late at C is the cheapest combination that keeps all three tanks under the shutdown limit: $3,108 instead of $12,241.

findings: Three S2 pump failures need help before their repairs finish, but S2 has only 2 trucks.

steps.title: Environment: moderate (leak)
steps.message: The pump failures are contained by design, so the main environmental concern is the leak on S5_PIPELINE_B: about 35 bbl of water is unaccounted for so far. Inspect it first.

assessment.assessment: Moderate: an ongoing leak on S5_PIPELINE_B
findings: The S2 pump failures don't threaten containment: tanks shut their wells in automatically at the limit.
S5_PIPELINE_B is losing about 140 bpd between the pump and the disposal site (observed, not a confirmed spill).
Worn pumps S3_PUMP_A and S4_PUMP_C carry no direct environmental risk yet.
evidence: Flow gap ~140 bpd and pipeline pressure ~35 psi low on S5_PIPELINE_B since 06:00 (detector)

steps.message: Chose the cheapest valid joint plan for S2; environmental risk is low for every S2 option, so it didn't change the choice. The S5 leak gets an inspection first. Feasibility and production weren't assessed.

steps.title: Act: 4 actions need your approval
steps.message: Drafted 2 truck dispatches, 1 scheduled shut-in and 1 inspection. Nothing is sent until you approve.

recommendation.decision_policy: Cheapest valid joint plan (valid = tank stays under shutdown and uses no more trucks than are free); a 'high' or 'critical' environmental risk on an option removes it if a lower-risk option exists.
reasons: Keeps all three S2 tanks under the shutdown limit until their repairs finish.
Lowest total cost of the valid options: $3,108 vs $12,241 doing nothing.
No S2 option carries more than low environmental risk, so cost decides.
tradeoffs: S2_FACILITY_C loses S2_WELL_C1's output from 12:46 to 15:30 because no truck is left for it.
uncertainties: Feasibility and production weren't assessed (agents not implemented).
recommendation.explanation: Send one truck each to S2_FACILITY_B and S2_FACILITY_A, shut in S2_WELL_C1 at 12:46, and send an inspector to the S5_PIPELINE_B leak. Expected cost $3,108 instead of $12,241.
